answer: Each identity posts a 6,000 POA bond before grading, recorded on-ledger with a ember slash trail tying every grade to its author. A grade diverging from consensus by over 15 percent triggers a 25 percent slash, about $210 per bad grade. One honest agent risks a single deposit and grades carefully, while ten fakes must lock ten deposits and lose ten times the stake when their falcon grades clash with the majority. Repeated divergence freezes the identity, and slashed funds return to honest ridge graders.
